system_description.narrative_title: Escalating US–Canada Trade War Over Tariffs
system_description.narrative_summary: A rapid breakdown in US–Canada trade talks has produced large unilateral tariff actions and pledged dollar-for-dollar Canadian retaliation, driving market volatility, supply-chain risk, and political backlash on both sides. The window shows a dynamic in which executive decisions on tariffs, short-term concessions (e.g., beef imports), and domestic political pressures interact to amplify economic and financial spillovers across autos, metals, agriculture and energy sectors. Uncertainty about deal durability and broader contagion to North American trade and global markets is the dominant force shaping the headlines.
system_description.scope: Bilateral trade policy decisions and retaliatory measures between the United States and Canada, including tariffs on autos, metals, agricultural products and electronics; related market responses (equities, FX, commodity futures); affected supply chains, firms and unions; domestic political reactions and short-term mitigation measures within both countries.
system_description.super_system: Global trade system and international political economy (multilateral trade rules, global supply chains, and geopolitics).
adjacent_subsystems: U.S. domestic politics and policy apparatus (executive decisions, Congress, producers/lobby groups)
Canadian domestic politics and economic policy (federal responses, provincial impacts, unions)
North American manufacturing and supply chains (autos, metals, agriculture, energy)
Global financial and commodity markets (investors, FX, futures, inflation expectations)
evidence_headlines: U.S. Imposes 50% Tariffs on Some Canadian Goods After Last-Ditch Talks Fail
Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on $20bn worth of US goods, unveils support measures
U.S., Canada Head Toward Trade War
Mark Carney says Canada is now ‘at war’ with US over trade
Donald Trump says deal reached with Canada and pauses tariffs

variables.name: Average applied tariff rate
variables.description: The weighted average level of import tariffs applied on goods crossing the bilateral border.

variables.name: Retaliatory reciprocity degree
variables.description: The extent to which tariff actions are met with proportional reciprocal measures by the counterparty.

variables.name: Trade policy uncertainty
variables.description: The perceived unpredictability of future trade measures and the risk of sudden policy shifts affecting bilateral trade.

variables.name: Negotiation intensity
variables.description: The frequency, urgency and scope of active policy negotiations addressing bilateral trade disputes.

variables.name: Supply-chain disruption level
variables.description: The accumulated degree of interruptions, delays and capacity shortfalls in cross-border supply chains.

variables.name: Bilateral goods flow
variables.description: The volume and value rate of goods moving across the bilateral border per unit time.

variables.name: Financial market volatility
variables.description: The magnitude of short-term price fluctuations in equity, bond and derivative markets linked to the dispute.

variables.name: Currency volatility
variables.description: The variability of the bilateral exchange rate and short-term currency movements associated with the trade conflict.

variables.name: Commodity price pressure
variables.description: The upward or downward pressure on prices of key traded commodities (metals, energy, agricultural) driven by trade actions.

variables.name: Investor risk sentiment
variables.description: The degree to which investors reprice risk for assets exposed to bilateral trade disruption and policy uncertainty.

variables.name: Corporate investment commitment
variables.description: The aggregated level of firms' planned capital expenditures and location decisions affected by bilateral trade conditions.

variables.name: Supply-chain reconfiguration rate
variables.description: The pace at which firms alter sourcing, production locations or logistics to reduce exposure to the bilateral partner.

variables.name: Import dependence
variables.description: The share of critical inputs and finished goods that the economy sources from the bilateral partner, indicating structural reliance.

variables.name: Domestic political pressure
variables.description: The intensity of domestic political demands on decision-makers to take protective or retaliatory trade actions.

variables.name: Multilateral rule constraint
variables.description: The strength and enforceability of international trade rules and dispute-resolution mechanisms constraining unilateral measures.

variables.name: Industrial interdependence
variables.description: The depth of cross-border integration in manufacturing and value chains that transmits shocks between economies.

catalysts.title: Canada retaliatory tariffs begin
catalysts.description: Canada's announced retaliatory tariff schedule is set to take effect, triggering reciprocal duties and support disbursements.
catalysts.rationale: Cites: 'As U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse, Carney says retaliatory tariffs will start Sept. 8' and Canada announces retaliatory tariffs.

catalysts.title: U.S. threatens 50% auto tariffs
catalysts.description: U.S. administration statements aim to raise tariffs on Canadian autos to 50%, risking broad escalation across vehicle supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: Cites: 'Trump says US to increase tariffs on Canadian cars to 50%' and 'Trump threatens 50% tariffs on all cars and trucks from Canada'.

catalysts.title: Canada $20bn tariff/support rollout
catalysts.description: Canada to implement $20bn retaliatory tariffs alongside domestic support measures, phasing interventions to shield affected sectors.
catalysts.rationale: Cites: 'Canada announces $20bn retaliatory tariffs...unveils support measures' and 'Canada to match U.S. tariffs dollar for dollar'.

catalysts.title: Resumption/intensification of trade talks
catalysts.description: Officials signal ongoing or imminent meetings to address tariffs; talks could either de-escalate or sharpen pledges depending on outcomes.
catalysts.rationale: Cites: 'Vance says talks with Canada ongoing' and 'Trump told Lula that officials should meet soon to discuss tariffs'.

catalysts.title: Automaker investment reassessments
catalysts.description: Major automakers publicly warn they may delay or cancel North American plant investments absent tariff resolution, prompting relocation and pause decisions.
catalysts.rationale: Cites: 'Honda says it may not build new plant in North America without trade deal extension' and 'Ford’s $3 billion Canadian bet...crosshairs'.

catalysts.title: Short-term market volatility spike
catalysts.description: Financial markets and FX react to tariff escalations and headlines, prompting repricing of Canada- and U.S.-exposed assets.
catalysts.rationale: Cites: 'Stock futures slip...' 'Canadian dollar slides as Ottawa and Washington head for all-out trade war' and ETF flows.

catalysts.title: CME zinc futures launch trades
catalysts.description: The start of U.S. zinc futures trading could alter metal hedging and price discovery amid tariff-driven supply concerns.
catalysts.rationale: Cites: 'CME Group launches U.S. zinc futures with first trades' and metal-tariff headlines.
